selection_basis: explicit project pins; unavailable platform tools remain interface-only until their approved runner exists

required_steps: open a toolchain-upgrade change with rationale and compatibility window
update toolchain.lock.json and every language-specific lock file
update CI consumers and local documentation in the same change
run the lock validator, root workspace checks, and affected platform smoke tests
record unavailable toolchains as blocked_environment rather than passing them
keep one previous compatible lock in the release notes for rollback
